svg.title: vn_weather_fabric architecture
svg.desc: Batch pipeline on Microsoft Fabric. Open-Meteo and provinces.open-api.vn feed lh_bronze, then lh_silver, then lh_gold, which a Direct Lake semantic model and a Power BI report read. A second lane moves the history from a simulated on-premises SQL Server through a data gateway into the same lakehouses, with a cutover date of 2024-01-01. A third lane, drawn dashed because it is not built yet, shows the planned near-real-time branch. A fourth lane shows the GitHub Actions CI and the manual Update all step.
svg.text: Hourly weather and PM2.5 for one representative city in each of Vietnam's 34 provinces, on Microsoft Fabric (Trial).
LANE 1 · BATCH · from the public APIs to the Power BI report
MICROSOFT FABRIC WORKSPACE · de_vn_prod · batch, refreshed every 2 hours
Logic lives in src/ and is tested with pytest;
notebooks import it. Writes use a Delta MERGE on
(city_id, ts), so a rerun adds no duplicates.
A row on the wrong side stops the notebook before any write.
Boundary check after each backfill writes to dq_results.
LANE 3 · NEAR-REAL-TIME · DESIGNED, NOT BUILT YET · micro-batch (a notebook polling), not a true stream
LANE 4 · CODE AND DELIVERY · single main branch, no dev or test workspace
PM2.5 is model data (CAMS Global, about a 45 km grid), not station measurements. · Each province is represented by one chosen city, so the data is a coarse view of the province.

The on-premises SQL Server is simulated (a container on a laptop) and was filled from the same Open-Meteo data, so the reconciliation proves the gateway path and the column mapping, not data correctness.
Weather and air quality: Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0; the free tier is non-commercial only). · Province names: provinces.open-api.vn (community-run, terms not verified).
